regression_domains: 96/192/384 AO complete forces and all four energy-only endpoints
automatic_promotion_domain: Only the already occupied-auto RTX 5090 768/768, RHF, batch-one, resident rank-160 domain. Diagnostic split4 may exercise other plans for correctness; that does not qualify their automatic use.
work_gate: Freeze input checkpoint D; keep warm updates disabled and require matched actual J/K builds, eigensolves, final checks/corrections, projection lease/reuse and converged SCF work. Expected three updates at 384/768 is checked, not forced. Retain changed-work samples separately and stop the fixed-work campaign on failure.
resources: Borrow four K matrices from already charged exchange_intermediate; no new owned storage. Preserve immutable raw A and final U. Report doubled leading Gram FLOPs, BLAS calls including tails, partial writes/reads and ascending FP64 reduction.
timing: Complete synchronized warm endpoints only, after all compilation; diagnostics and sampled resource peaks run separately. Finite Slurm allocation preserves scheduler device visibility.
external_claims: No GPU4PySCF claim; #206 retains fresh matched comparison and separate/combined ablation requirements.
regression_statistic: Ratio of the seven-sample candidate median to the seven-sample baseline median; require <=1.03 for each declared regression endpoint.
